name: Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago National Cyber Security Strategy (2012)
owner: Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TT-CSIRT)
description: Government of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago National Cyber Security Strategy (December 2012). National cybersecurity strategy of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago prepared by the Inter-Ministerial Committee for Cyber Security across governance, incident management (establishing TT-CSIRT), critical infrastructure protection, legal reform, and culture/awareness.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TT-CSIRT) (ttcsirt.gov.tt) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Trinidad and Tobago Cyber Security Incident Response Team (TT-CSIRT) (ttcsirt.gov.tt).
